company_notes:
POC focused on sub-100ms tail latency for interactive chat and sub-$0.001/token effective cost. Highly latency-sensitive: customer-facing chat for trading desk alerts and personalization. Primary ask: measurement harness + tuning suggestions (batching thresholds, prefix/KV caching rules, model quantization profile).
- Wants RTX-like p95 <= 80ms for prompts up to 256 tokens, sustained 500 rps with burst to 1200 rps.
- Cost target: reduce per-token spend by 40% vs current hosted provider via batching + 4-bit quantization without >3% quality regression.
- Routing: region-aware low-latency routing with fallback to smaller model variant; need graceful degradation plan.
- Compliance: SOC2 required, KMS with customer-managed keys, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Quote from CTO: "We will accept small latency variance if it buys us 30-40% cost reduction — but not at the expense of hallucination spikes."
- Technical constraints: existing infra in GCP us-central, strict egress rules (so VPC peering or private link required).
- Currently evaluating Dedicated pool + Redwood Optimize recommendations; also testing hosted API for quick failover prototype.
- Want token-level cost/latency breakdown (console) and an eval suite to run nightly perf regressions.
- POC asks: 2-week run, Redwood to provide perf harness and suggested batching/cache configs, deliver report with p50/p95/p99 and token-cost breakdown.
- Procurement notes: legal asking for data residency amendment; finance expects final pricing before end of April.
